Subject: Audit logging capabilities + SOC 2 posture (post-demo recap)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Thanks again for taking the time to demo Acme's use case with our runtime earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Audit logging: we capture admin activity (console sign-ins, role changes), API-level request/response logs (request metadata, model ID, token usage), and task-level events (rollouts, scale events). Logs are available via streaming webhook, S3-compatible export, and in the Console Logs view.
- Immutability/export: we provide append-only event stores for audit logs when customers enable retention policies; exports are delivered as gzipped JSON/NDJSON and can be signed for integrity.
- SOC 2: Redwood is mid-cycle; we completed readiness and are undergoing Type II audit fieldwork with a target completion of Q4 2026. We can provide our SOC 2 Type I report and a status timeline today.
- GDPR/HIPAA: we support data locality and offer BAAs for private deployments. For hosted accounts, we have controls and contractual language we can share.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (SOC 2 Type I stub) and a pre-filled vendor security questionnaire for Acme to review.

Proposed next steps:
1) Rishi and Dev to provide a brief tech writeup (1 pager) on log schemas and retention/export options by EOD tomorrow.
2) Alice to share any specific fields they must capture for compliance (user id, IP, model prompt redaction requirements) so we can map them.
3) We'll schedule a short technical follow-up (30 min) with your security team — availability Thursday or Friday?

Thanks,

- SOC 2 timeline: Q4 2026 for Type II is acceptable, but we'll need the Type I report and control matrix for our procurement team this week.

Adding the tech details requested. Draft below for the 1-pager we agreed to share — feel free to edit before I send to Acme.

- Log types: admin_activity, api_requests, model_inference_events, deployment_events, billing_events. Each event includes timestamp (ISO8601), actor_id, actor_type (user/service), action, resource_id, region, request_id, and optional payload.
- Prompt handling: We support configurable prompt capture levels per workspace: none / hashed / full. For PII we recommend hashing at ingest and storing raw prompt only in a customer-managed KMS-backed envelope (Private deployment) or masked in hosted mode. Exports can either include hashed prompts or full prompts if customer enables export with encrypted envelope.
- Immutability & signed exports: Export bundles include a signed manifest (SHA256) and can be delivered to S3 with object lock (governance mode) or to your archival system. We can also provide a signed timestamp from our log-signing service as part of the bundle for chain-of-custody.
- Retention: retention policies are configurable per-log-type; default retention is 90 days for hosted accounts, longer for Dedicated/Private. We can support 2+ years for compliance customers via archival export.

I'll attach the 1-pager and the sample log schema. Marissa — send when ready.

Thanks,
Rishi
